caption: The drawing depicts a single, ornate tankard placed centrally on the paper, rendered in graphite with soft shading to emphasize the metallic sheen and reflective surface of the vessel. The tankard features a bulbous body, a tall and curved spout, a domed lid with a round finial at the top, and a large, decorative handle ending in a curved flourish at the base. The handle is attached to the side of the tankard near the top and bottom. The tankard stands on a rounded, slightly flared foot. The background consists of light, irregular brownish-orange stains or washes that frame the tankard and extend to the edges of the sheet, including inside a faint rectangular border surrounding the tankard and background. In the lower right corner, there is a small inscription indicating the object type and details: "TANKARD 1790-1813 About 10" tall (CASE No. 7)". The drawing is monochromatic in the depiction of the tankard using shades of gray, while the background adds a contrasting warmth with its uneven brownish-orange color.
title: Silver Tankard
